title: Screen Ray And Hit Test Query

specification.title: Screen Ray And Hit Test Query
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Picking object/face/edge/vertex, selection set, gizmo hooks và hover hit-tests.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tự tạo F6/Matrix Gumball UI hoặc Clayoo sub-object modes.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Screen Ray And Hit Test Query” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Screen Ray And Hit Test Query”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Screen Ray And Hit Test Query
execution_design.positive_case: Box tại tâm tia, điểm click ở viewport P trúng BodyId của box
execution_design.negative_case: Ray không giao đối tượng trả danh sách rỗng, không chọn
execution_design.algorithm_hint: Từ pixel+camera+rect tạo ray 3D; lọc hit BRep/mesh theo depth và ID ổn định; không lấy triangle index làm face ID

proposed_fixture.algorithm_and_coverage: Từ pixel+camera+rect tạo ray 3D; lọc hit BRep/mesh theo depth và ID ổn định; không lấy triangle index làm face ID
proposed_fixture.tolerance_policy: Use document absolute tolerance of M01; do not guess at source pin; pixel threshold calibrated for DPR.

runtime_implementation.hover_source_copy_worker_2026_11_14: Large-scene hover source validation and copying runs on one admitted cancelable worker; its captured document is released before picking. Headless New/cancel/pressure and retry/permit fixtures pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-detached-hover-source.md#source-copy-preparation-on-the-worker
runtime_implementation.detached_hover_source_2026_11_14: Background hover uses an admitted document-independent picking snapshot with exact curve copies and display pins, and rejects a changed scene publication. Headless parity, source lifetime, pressure and stale-result fixtures pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-detached-hover-source.md

grip_hover_regressions_2026_11_13.scope: Grip drag and Gumball overlap, small-motion input, and parallel-ray hover fixture have targeted egui coverage.
grip_hover_regressions_2026_11_13.limitations: Physical desktop and general snap combinations remain unverified; source/display separation and cold restore remain open.

runtime_implementation.scene_occurrence_overlay_2026_11_13: Headless egui selection overlays use the published occurrence display after source-stamp validation; tested temporary OCCT/NativeBrep box edges and a translated B-rep instance. Ordinary display remains document-backed and desktop unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-scene-occurrence-selection-overlay.md
runtime_implementation.curved_overlap_admission_2026_11_13: One reopened affine cylinder and front point produced a depth-ordered egui chooser with either row selectable; unsupported curved sources are skipped before large admission/OCCT, verified under simulated pressure. Physical desktop and broad geometry remain open. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-fallback-source-selection.md#overlap-chooser-and-unsupported-source-admission
runtime_implementation.curved_trim_fallback_gap_2026_11_13: Reopened exact-constructor cylinders now select valid rear material in tested scale/shear and reflection/shear placements, with numeric guards and refusal checks. General affine and curved geometry and physical desktop remain unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-fallback-source-selection.md#affine-cylinder-source-pick-follow-up

trim_fallback_window_and_occlusion_2026_.scope: The application egui input path selects an unsupported trim through an enclosing window without document changes. Scene-level occlusion still treats a point outside that trim as blocked by its fallback display.
trim_fallback_window_and_occlusion_2026_.remaining: Source-aware occlusion and actual desktop interaction remain open.

trim_fallback_selection_guard_2026_11_12.scope: Point and crossing selection skip unverified fallback surface; nested-loop fixture selects the object behind and permits enclosing-window selection of the fallback. Scene suite and source audit passed.
trim_fallback_selection_guard_2026_11_12.remaining: Accurate point/crossing selection, rendering of unverified trim, physical desktop and general topology remain open.

many_edge_trim_scene_2026_11_12.scope: A 129-edge planar trim now displays, picks material and exposes the object behind the exterior; full and incremental scene preflight fixture passed.
many_edge_trim_scene_2026_11_12.remaining: Unsupported trim fallback can still pick outside its outer boundary. Desktop and near-limit responsiveness remain unverified.

unsupported_trim_fallback_2026_11_12.scope: Scene fallback for a valid 129-edge planar trim picks a point outside the trim; desired acceptance test fails and is ignored. Regular selection batch 13 passed and one ignored; source audit passed.
unsupported_trim_fallback_2026_11_12.remaining: Source-aware selection, bounded admission and product/desktop behavior remain open.

runtime_implementation.scope: Point/curve/mesh screen rays, clipping and deterministic hit IDs; source-bound native BRep topology UUID mapping validated

remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

fallback_source_selection_2026_11_13.scope: Ordinary point selection on an untrimmed fallback now uses source ray/UV validation and a bounded strict-convexity certificate for affine planar trims with one outer loop and at most 1024 vertices. A reopened 708-edge fixture, inside/outside/boundary, affine placement, nested occurrence, permissions, overlap chooser, simulated pressure and missing-tolerance refusal passed. Full support display remains warned. UI tests matrix selection 4, rubber band 7, shell docking 11 and two controller tests passed; no-default check passed.
fallback_source_selection_2026_11_13.remaining: Nonconvex or holed fallbacks, curved sources, subobject selection, Surface Snap, physical desktop, actual OOM, native peak and synchronous click latency on complex drawings remain unverified. Plan A open; B1-B3 deferred.
fallback_source_selection_2026_11_13.next_action: Broaden only with reliable topology, numerical and latency evidence; update debug adapter after active windows are saved and closed.

fallback_source_pick_timing_2026_11_13.scope: On Ryzen 9 5900X, five warm sequential debug helper samples for 708 vertices were 132715,132728,132897,132605,133327 us before and 11477,11453,11457,11468,11462 us after; for 1024 vertices they were 276949,276496,276288,277176,276373 us before and 22788,22816,22806,22796,22782 us after. A global magnitude upper bound remains at least as conservative as the original per-pair bound. Focused certificate tests, sampled differential reference, matrix selection 4 and rubber band 7 passed.
fallback_source_pick_timing_2026_11_13.remaining: Uncontrolled sequential debug helper timing only; full frame, release, desktop, arbitrary input and general latency remain unverified. The screen can refuse more borderline cases. Plan A open; B1-B3 deferred.
fallback_source_pick_timing_2026_11_13.next_action: Continue source-based selection for unsupported trims with topology/numerical evidence; verify desktop once active windows are saved and closed.

fallback_convex_holes_2026_11_13.scope: Source fallback selection now verifies convex holes lie inside the convex outer loop and are mutually separated using polygon-edge half-planes, with a combined 1024-vertex cap. A reopened planar fixture with 708 outer edges and one hole selected material but not the hole in egui while preserving document/Redo. Unit checks cover intersecting, nested, near, concave and outside holes, reversed winding and separated diagonal holes whose axis bounds overlap; managed pressure refusal/retry passed. Matrix selection 4, rubber band 8, focused fallback 6/1 ignored and no-default check passed. Five warm debug helper samples for the one-hole fixture were 11650,11648,11657,11644,11661 us on Ryzen 9 5900X.
fallback_convex_holes_2026_11_13.remaining: General nonconvex loops, curved surfaces, ambiguous topology, actual desktop, physical OOM and native peak remain unverified; source selection still has a bounded synchronous proof and full-surface fallback display. Plan A remains open; B1-B3 deferred.
fallback_convex_holes_2026_11_13.next_action: Continue source-accurate handling for nonconvex or curved fallback and verify desktop after active windows are saved and closed.
